llmJudgeRequirements.description: App component renders `QueryClientProvider` with `client` set to `queryClient` and wraps `TodosScreen`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: App component returns QueryClientProvider with client={queryClient} wrapping TodosScreen
evidence: export default function App() { return (<QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}><TodosScreen /></QueryClientProvider>) }

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Toggle flow uses `useMutation` object form with `mutationFn` `onMutate` `onError` and `onSettled` callbacks
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useMutation called with object containing mutationFn, onMutate, onError, and onSettled keys
evidence: const mutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: ..., onMutate: ..., onError: ..., onSettled: ... })

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must call `cancelQueries` from `onMutate`, read snapshot with `getQueryData`, and write optimistic list with `setQueryData`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: onMutate calls cancelQueries, reads snapshot via getQueryData, and writes optimistic update via setQueryData

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must read snapshot from `onError` and restore it through `setQueryData`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: onError reads previous snapshot from context and restores it via setQueryData

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Row press callback must trigger mutation
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Pressable onPress calls handleToggle which calls mutation.mutate with id and nextDone
evidence: const handleToggle = (todo: Todo) => { mutation.mutate({ id: todo.id, nextDone: !todo.done }) }

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Failure text is rendered only when mutation error state is set.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Error text is rendered conditionally on errorVisible, which is set true only in onError and false on new mutation
evidence: {errorVisible && (<Text style={styles.error}>Toggle failed. Cache rolled back and revalidated.</Text>)}
